newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lebed says enlargement is for NATO to decide.
newsitem.headline: Lebed says enlargement is for NATO to decide.

text.p: Russian Security Chief Alexander Lebed said on Monday that any decision on enlarging the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation would be a decision for NATO.
"Whatever NATO decides, Russia is not going to go into hysterics," he told a news conference.
"Politically and legally, any legitimate organisation can join what it wants to," Lebed said after a visit to NATO headquarters, his first visit to the West.
"But our question is regarding the political legitimacy of the timing of this expansion," he said.
Russia has been at odds with NATO over the alliance's plans to expand to include countries such as Poland and Hungary.
